description: Which tracked Base opportunities depend on an entity (protocol, stablecoin, oracle, curator), with their total TVL. Useful for sizing the impact of an exploit, depeg or oracle failure. Entity ids appear in dependency graphs, for example protocol:morpho-blue. Unknown ids answer 404 and invalid arguments 400 before any payment; 503 while data refreshes; charged only for a 200. Price: $0.01 USDC on Base (x402), charged only for a successful answer.

entity.description: Entity id: protocol:<slug>, stablecoin:<id>, oracle:<name>, curator:<name> or issuer:<name>, as found in dependency graphs.

name: get_dependents
